valley.definition: An long, low area between hills or mountains, often with a river running through it.

valuable.definition: If something is valuable it has great value. That is, it would cost a large amount of money.
valuable.sentence: Gold is a very valuable metal.

value.definition: Something's value is how good or important it is; how much money someone will exchange a thing for; an amount of money.
value.sentence: Human life has very much value.

van.definition: A van is a long vehicle (like a car) with four wheels and an engine (or motor).

variable.definition: A variable is something that may not always be the same.
variable.sentence: The weather is one variable to be considered.

variation.definition: A variation of something is the same thing, but changed a little bit.
variation.sentence: There was a lot of variation in price among the stores.

variety.definition: A variety of things is a group of things that are not all the same.
variety.sentence: Americans can buy a wide variety of cheap products at local supermarkets.

various.definition: Various ways, types, kinds, etc. are many different ones.
various.sentence: I've made the dish a number of times in various ways. It's never the same.

vary.definition: If something varies, it is not always the same.
vary.sentence: Teachers sometimes need to vary the order and manner in which things are taught and learnt.

vast.definition: If something is vast, it is very, very big.
vast.sentence: Tax rates will go up for the vast majority of the population.

vegetable.definition: A vegetable a part of a plant that is good for eating. This does not include grain, but does include leaves, stems, and roots. Some fruits are also called vegetables but most are not.

vehicle.definition: A vehicle is something that moves people or things from one place to another, for example: cars, planes, boats, etc.
vehicle.sentence: His editorials provided a vehicle for his political views.

venture.sentence: My venture into television production was successful.

verb.definition: To verb a word is to turn it into a verb.

version.definition: A version is something that exists in different forms.
version.sentence: The North American version of the car will have a larger engine.

very.definition: Much; quite. Using very makes the adjective or adverb stronger.

vessel.definition: A vessel is a pot or container.
vessel.sentence: She poured the milk into another vessel.

veteran.definition: A veteran is a person with long experience of a particular activity.

vice.definition: A vice is an immoral or bad habit.

victim.definition: A victim is the person hurt in a crime.

victory.definition: A victory is the act or result of winning.
victory.sentence: The Korean War had no clear victory.

video.definition: A video is a television show or movie.
video.sentence: We watched a video in class.

view.sentence: He had a view of the fight.

village.definition: A village is a very small town.
village.sentence: He lives in a village in the middle of nowhere.

violence.definition: Violence is an action done to hurt somebody or something.
violence.sentence: I don't watch boxing, because I don't like all the fighting and violence.

violent.definition: If someone is violent, they act physically to hurt people or break things.
violent.sentence: Police said he had a history of violent behavior.

virtually.definition: Just about; almost but not quite.
virtually.sentence: Once you put it on, it is virtually impossible to remove.

virus.definition: A virus is a very small thing that can make people sick by getting into a living cell to copy itself.
virus.sentence: Bigotry is a virus that must not be allowed to spread.

visible.definition: If something is visible, it can be seen.
visible.sentence: The car had no visible signs of damage.

vision.definition: Vision is being able to see with your eyes.
vision.sentence: Now I'm old and my vision is not very good, so I don't drive a car any more.

visit.definition: When you visit someone, you meet the person.
visit.sentence: I visit my friend Bethsy at her house every Tuesday.

visual.definition: Visual things are those related to sight and seeing.
visual.sentence: The visual part of the play was beautiful, but the voices were too quiet.

vital.definition: Something that is vital is something that is needed to live.

voice.sentence: His voice was deep and clear.

volume.definition: The volume of sound or music is how loud it is.
volume.sentence: Hey! Turn down the volume. It's too loud.

voluntary.definition: Acting of one's own free will. Something that somebody does is voluntary if the person is doing it because they want to do it, not because someone orders them to do it.
voluntary.sentence: Helping to wash the dishes is voluntary.

volunteer.definition: A volunteer is someone who does work because they want to, without being paid.

vote.definition: A vote is a formal way of choosing things that are controlled by the majority.
vote.sentence: Let's take a vote for a new president!

voter.definition: A voter is someone who votes.
